item_name: Rothco PVC Thin Blue Line Flag Patch - Hook Back
item_short_desc: Show your support for the police and law enforcement officers with the Rothco PVC Thin Blue Line Flag Patch.
description: Show your support for the police and law enforcement officers with the Rothco PVC Thin Blue Line Flag Patch. This PVC US Flag comes subdued with a Thin Blue Line across this middle. It features a hook backing to attach to any loop field and measures 1 7/8" x 3 3/8". Patches with the item #’s starting with ‘P’ are individually packaged with a header card.
